title: Oklahoma's Bowl Streak: How Many Straight Years in the Postseason?
question: How many consecutive bowl games has Oklahoma played in?
answer: Oklahoma played in a bowl game 26 straight seasons, from 1999 through the 2024 Armed Forces Bowl, then reached the College Football Playoff in 2025. That makes 27 consecutive postseason appearances through the 2025 season.
summary: OU went bowling 26 straight seasons from 1999 through the 2024 Armed Forces Bowl, then made the 2025 CFP, a 27-year postseason run. Here is how it stacks up.
body: Oklahoma's postseason streak began in Bob Stoops's first season, 1999, and has not stopped since. The Sooners played in a bowl game every year from 1999 through 2024, a run of 26 consecutive bowl seasons.

The 26th bowl came in the 2024 Armed Forces Bowl against Navy at Amon G. Carter Stadium in Fort Worth, after a 6-6 regular season in Oklahoma's first year in the SEC. The Sooners lost 21-20 to finish 6-7, but the streak survived. Georgia, playing in its 28th straight postseason that year, owned a longer active run.
That 2024 trip was Oklahoma's 58th bowl appearance overall, fourth-most in college football behind Alabama (78), Georgia (63) and Texas (60) at the time.

In 2025, the Sooners went bigger. Brent Venables's team finished 10-3, earned the No. 8 seed in the College Football Playoff and hosted No. 9 Alabama in Norman on Dec. 19, 2025. Oklahoma jumped ahead 17-0 before the Crimson Tide rallied to win 34-24, but the appearance pushed OU's consecutive postseason run to 27 seasons.
So the trivia answer depends on how you count: 26 straight bowl games from 1999 to 2024, or 27 straight postseason appearances if you include the 2025 playoff game.
